reason: Most days I just buy a plate for 50-60 baht downstairs, it is quicker than cooking in my little condo corner. I might open the free dishes once out of curiosity, but I would not pay 99 baht ahead for dishes I do not have yet.
objection: Five dishes, then I have to wait and pay for more that do not exist yet. I already know how to make kra pao, and I have no time to cook most evenings anyway.
would_change_my_mind: If the 12-dish pack were already ready to use today, and the cook-ahead plan really fed my family cheaper than street food on busy weeks.
